title: Bahrain Victorious Rider Alberto Bruttomesso Provisionally Suspended in Doping Case
content:
Italian anti-doping authorities provisionally suspend the 22-year-old WorldTour rider, but do not reveal details about the case.

Read the full article at Bahrain Victorious Rider Alberto Bruttomesso Provisionally Suspended in Doping Case on Velo.
